dedupe_keys.name: spslux gnss reference station raw data luxembourg

description: The Luxembourg national mapping agency, the Administration du cadastre et de la topographie (ACT), runs SPSLux, the national GNSS network real-time kinematic correction service, which uses raw data from national and international continuously operating reference stations. For post-processing, ACT offers raw observations from the national reference stations as 24-hour files at 30-second intervals, and hourly files at 1-second intervals for the last three months, in RINEX 3.04 format for GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou; these are free of charge on request to the customer service centre and are generally available within 24 hours. Annual aggregations of the raw data from the stations in Luxembourg are published on the national open data portal in RINEX format under a CC0 licence, starting in 2011, with 15 files, an annual update frequency and a latest update on 2 February 2026. Caveats noted on the open data page: the network configuration has changed over time as stations were added, removed or renamed, and Galileo and BeiDou signals were added progressively alongside GPS and GLONASS. Coverage is Luxembourg and the surrounding region. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, ground deformation monitoring and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are WALCORS of Wallonia and ASG-EUPOS of Poland.
